\chapter{Introduction to Greedy Algorithms}
\label{ch:introduction}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Make the locally best choice and never look back --- when that is safe, greedy is the simplest and fastest algorithm there is.}}
\end{tcolorbox}
